pages.body:
Why This Book Exists


Have you ever watched a sunset? It is beautiful. The colors are stunning. But it does not last. The light fades. The shadows grow. The night comes. And then the sun rises again. The light returns. It is eternal.


The Old Covenant is like a sunset. It was beautiful. It was given by God. It had colors and shadows and rituals that were stunning. But it was not meant to last forever. It was meant to fade. It was meant to point to something greater. It was meant to point to the sunrise. It was meant to point to Jesus.


This book is for the curious. It is for the spiritual seeker who senses there is more. It is for the person who has seen the shadows and wants to see the light. Over the next 30 days, we are going to look at the Old Covenant. We are going to see its beauty. We are going to see its limitations. We are going to see its purpose. And we are going to discover that every shadow was pointing to an eternal light. That light is Jesus.


The Value You Will Get


By the end of this book, you will not see the Old Covenant as a failed experiment. You will see it as a divine preparation. You will understand why it was given. You will understand why it faded. You will see the spiritual meaning behind the symbols. And you will have a new appreciation for the New Covenant. You will see that the light is not fading. The light is eternal.


How to Use This Guide


This is a 30 day journey. Each day takes about 10 minutes. Read the hook. Read the ancient text. Read the fulfillment. Read the verdict. Read the resonance. Read the prayer. If you are not sure how to pray, just read the words out loud. God hears honest words. He is not looking for fancy language. He is looking for your heart.


---

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever signed a contract? Maybe you signed a lease. Maybe you signed a job offer. Maybe you signed a loan. A contract is a binding agreement. It has terms. It has conditions. If you break the terms, there are consequences. The Old Covenant was a contract. And it was a contract of works.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"Now if you obey me fully and keep my covenant, then out of all nations you will be my treasured possession." - Exodus 19:5 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God made a covenant with Israel at Mount Sinai. It was a conditional covenant. It said, "If you obey me fully, then you will be my treasured possession." It was based on works. It was based on performance. It was based on obedience. The people said, "Everything the LORD has said we will do." They agreed to the terms. But they could not keep them. And neither can we.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—not by works, so that no one can boast." - Ephesians 2:8-9


Jesus is the fulfillment of the covenant of works. He kept the terms. He obeyed fully. He was the treasured possession. And because He kept the covenant, we are saved by grace. Not by works. Not by performance. Not by obedience. By grace. Through faith. It is a gift.


The Verdict
The covenant of works was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you feel like you have to earn God's love? Do you feel like you have to perform? Do you feel like you have to be good enough? Remember the covenant of works. Remember Jesus. He kept the covenant for you. You are saved by grace.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for keeping the covenant for me. Thank you for obeying fully. Thank you for being the treasured possession. Thank you for grace. Thank you for faith. Thank you for the gift. Help me to stop trying to earn your love. Help me to receive it. Amen.

The Hook
Have you ever read the law of Moses? It is a lot of rules. There are rules about food. There are rules about clothing. There are rules about farming. There are rules about disease. There are 613 commandments in the law of Moses. That is a lot of rules. And it was a shadow.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"These are the commands, decrees and laws the LORD your God directed me to teach you to observe." - Deuteronomy 6:1 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The law of Moses was given to Israel. It was given to show them how to live. It was given to set them apart. It was given to reveal sin. It was given to point to a savior. It was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ." - John 1:17


Jesus is the fulfillment of the law. He is the grace. He is the truth. He did not come to abolish the law. He came to fulfill it. He kept every commandment. He was the perfect law-keeper. And because He kept the law, we are free from the law. We are under grace.


The Verdict
The law of Moses was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you feel burdened by the law? Do you feel like you can never measure up? Remember the law of Moses. Remember Jesus. He kept the law for you. You are free.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for fulfilling the law. Thank you for keeping every commandment. Thank you for the grace. Thank you for the truth. Help me to live in freedom. Help me to live in grace. Amen.

The Hook
Have you ever wondered why there were so many sacrifices in the Old Testament? There were burnt offerings. There were grain offerings. There were peace offerings. There were sin offerings. There were guilt offerings. There were offerings for everything. It was a system. And it was a shadow.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"For the life of a creature is in the blood, and I have given it to you to make atonement for yourselves on the altar; it is the blood that makes atonement for one's life." - Leviticus 17:11 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The sacrificial system was given by God. It was given to teach the people about sin. It was given to teach them about atonement. It was given to teach them about substitution. An animal died so the person could live. It was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God." - 1 Peter 3:18


Jesus is the fulfillment of the sacrificial system. He is the sacrifice. He is the substitute. He suffered once for sins. The righteous for the unrighteous. He brought us to God. The sacrificial system was a rehearsal. The reality is the cross.


The Verdict
The sacrificial system was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you need a substitute? Do you need someone to take your place? Remember the sacrificial system. Remember Jesus. He was the substitute. He took your place.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the sacrifice. Thank you for being the substitute. Thank you for suffering once for sins. Thank you for bringing me to God. Help me to live in the power of your sacrifice. Amen.

Jesus, thank you for being the reality. Thank you for being the substance. Thank you for being the fulfillment of the shadow. Help me to stop living in the shadow. Help me to live in the reality. Help me to live in you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 19: The Shadow

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
The substance is the real thing. It is the thing the shadow pointed to. It is Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation." - Colossians 1:15 (Written around 60 A.D.)


Jesus is the image of the invisible God. He is the firstborn over all creation. He is the substance. He is the reality. He is the one the shadows pointed to.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity lives in bodily form, and in Christ you have been brought to fullness. He is the head over every power and authority." - Colossians 2:9-10


Jesus is the fullness. He is the deity. He is the head. He is the substance. And in Him, we have been brought to fullness. We have been brought to the reality.


The Verdict
The substance was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you want to be full? Do you want to be complete? Remember the substance. Remember Jesus. He is the fullness. He is the completion.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the substance. Thank you for being the fullness. Thank you for being the reality. Help me to live in your fullness. Help me to live in your reality. Amen.
pages.title: Day 20: The Substance

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
The temple was a building. The new temple is a person. The new temple is Jesus. And the new temple is you.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"I have indeed built a magnificent temple for you, a place for you to dwell forever." - 1 Kings 8:13 (Written around 950 B.C.)


The temple was built by Solomon. It was the dwelling place of God. It was where God met with His people. It was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus. And it pointed to you.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Don't you know that you yourselves are God's temple and that God's Spirit dwells in your midst?" - 1 Corinthians 3:16


You are the new temple. You are the dwelling place of God. You are where God meets with His people. You are the fulfillment of the temple. You are the new temple.


The Verdict
The new temple was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus. And it points to you. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is you in Christ.


The Resonance

The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for making me the temple of God. Thank you for your Spirit living in me. Thank you for making me the dwelling place of God. Help me to live like the temple I am. Amen.
pages.title: Day 21: The New Temple

pages.title: Day 22: The New Priesthood

pages.body:

The sacrifice was given by God. It was given to teach the people about sin. It was given to teach them about atonement. It was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus. And it points to you.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God's mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your true and proper worship." - Romans 12:1


You are the new sacrifice. You are a living sacrifice. You are holy and pleasing to God. You are the fulfillment of the sacrifice.

pages.title: Day 23: The New Sacrifice

pages.body:

"This is the covenant I will make with the people of Israel after that time," declares the LORD. "I will put my law in their minds and write it on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people." - Jeremiah 31:33 (Written around 600 B.C.)


The New Covenant was promised by God. It was promised to write the law on their hearts. It was promised to be their God. It was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus. And it points to you.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"For this reason Christ is the mediator of a new covenant, that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance—now that he has died as a ransom to set them free from the sins committed under the first covenant." - Hebrews 9:15


You are the New Covenant. You are the one who receives the promised eternal inheritance. You are the one who is set free. You are the fulfillment of the New Covenant.

The New Covenant was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus. And it points to you. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is you in Christ.

The Prayer

pages.title: Day 24: The New Covenant

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
The old creation was a shadow. The new creation is a reality. The new creation is Jesus. And the new creation is you.

The new creation was promised by God. It was promised to be a new heavens and a new earth. It was promised to be a place where the former things are not remembered. It was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus. And it points to you.

pages.title: Day 25: The New Creation

pages.body:

pages.title: Day 26: The New Heart

pages.body:

pages.title: Day 27: The New Spirit

pages.body:

pages.title: Day 28: The New Commandment

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
The old life was a shadow. The new life is a reality. The new life is Jesus. And the new life is you.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me." - Galatians 2:20 (Written around 50 A.D.)


The old life was a shadow. It was a life of sin. It was a life of death. It was a life of separation. It was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus. And it points to you.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me." - Galatians 2:20

The Verdict
The new life was a shadow. It pointed to a person. It pointed to Jesus. And it points to you. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is you in Christ.

pages.title: Day 29: The New Life

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
The shadows are fading. The light is eternal. The light is Jesus. And the light is you.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"The law is only a shadow of the good things that are coming—not the realities themselves." - Hebrews 10:1 (Written around 60 A.D.)


The law was a shadow. It was a shadow of the good things that are coming. It was a shadow of the realities themselves. It was a shadow of Jesus. The law could not make perfect. The sacrifices could not make perfect. They were shadows. They were pointing to something greater. They were pointing to the light.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"There will be no more night. They will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun, for the Lord God will give them light. And they will reign for ever and ever." - Revelation 22:5


Jesus is the eternal light. He is the light that never fades. He is the light that shines forever. He is the fulfillment of the shadow. He is the reality. He is the eternal light.


The Verdict
The shadows are fading. The light is eternal. The light is Jesus. And the light is you. The pattern is exact. The shadow is precise. The substance is Jesus.


The Resonance
You have the real thing. You have Jesus. You do not need to keep looking at shadows. You can live in the reality. You can live in the light. You can live in Christ. And one day, you will live in the eternal light forever.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the eternal light. Thank you for being the reality. Thank you for being the fulfillment of the shadow. Help me to stop living in the shadow. Help me to live in the light. Help me to live in you. Amen.



END MATTER


The 30-Day Light Challenge
You have journeyed through 30 days of shadows and light. Now what? I challenge you to read the book of Hebrews. It is 13 chapters. It is the perfect follow-up to this book. It will show you how Jesus is greater than the angels, greater than Moses, greater than the priests, and greater than the sacrifices. As you read, look for the shadows. Look for the light. Look for Jesus.


A Note on Faith
The shadows are evidence. They are evidence of a divine plan. But evidence does not save you. The shadows point to a person. The shadows point to Jesus. You can understand the shadows and still miss the light. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The shadows are on the table. The door is open. It is your choice.


About the Author
Christine A. writes for the spiritually curious. He is passionate about showing people the hidden wisdom of the Bible. He lives with his family and enjoys good coffee and long conversations with skeptics. He believes that honest questions deserve honest answers.
